defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: A restored --no-acl dump was structurally valid but atp_runtime could not read it.
defect_found_and_fixed.cause: PostgreSQL default privileges are database-local and --no-acl intentionally excludes grants.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Alembic now reconciles current table, sequence and function grants plus same-database default grants after every online migration.
defect_found_and_fixed.security_boundary: The runtime role receives DML, sequence and function access but no schema CREATE, CREATEDB, CREATEROLE or superuser capability.
